title: Capability classes and the concrete model each provider currently binds to them

resolution.description: harness: values are native model ids the harness resolves, or null for its own default of the tier the class rides. model-id: values are canonical vendor/model ids the launcher resolves, shims applied. engine: values are the model id a one-shot engine is run with on its own command line (the openai column: Codex, a bare gpt-… id); no session, export, shim or agent file, and the provider's adapter (tools/fabric/routing.py) says which classes it serves — a class it does not serve is absent here, never null.

^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.description: A canonical model id (vendor/model) on a model-id provider; on a harness provider a native model id (claude-…) that pins the class, or null for the harness's own current model of the tier the class rides; on an engine provider the engine's own bare id (gpt-…). Never a tier alias — which alias a class rides is runtime/claude-code/aliases.json's — and never a composite: `@preset/...` is a shim and is attached at runtime.
